nodes.content: For every n>=5, all entrywise nonnegative singular real n-by-n matrices A with total sum1 and PAP=(t/n)P, t>0, satisfy t<=(sqrt(n)-1)/(sqrt(n)+1). Equality forces, up to simultaneous coordinate permutation, A=(n-1)^-1 sum_i ell_i^T ell_i, ell_i=(1-1/sqrt(n))e_i+(1/sqrt(n))e_n.
nodes.scope: No symmetry, positive-semidefiniteness, or factorization ansatz is imposed. The proof gives a left-null-vector normal form, a sharp concavity/AM-GM bound, and every equality case.
